title.value: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document, indicating that it is focused on a library called GAUCHE designed for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry.
title.quote: We introduce GAUCHE, an open-source library for GAUssian processes in CHEmistry.

extractions.description: This paper introduces GAUCHE, an open-source library designed to facilitate the use of Gaussian processes in chemistry. It provides a robust and user-friendly framework for molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimization, and protein design by offering specialized kernels for various molecular representations.

primary_category.justification: The primary purpose of the paper is to present a tool that can be used in molecular discovery, which has applications in optimizing chemical processes and potentially reducing environmental impacts, thus contributing to climate change mitigation.
primary_category.quote: Motivated by scenarios frequently encountered in practice, we showcase applications for GAUCHE in molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimisation and protein design.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's focus on improving chemical reactions and molecular design through advanced computational methods positions it within the industry sub-category, as it aims to optimize industrial chemical processes.
primary_sub_category.quote: Extending Gaussian processes to molecular representations, however, necessitates kernels defined over structured inputs such as graphs, strings and bit vectors.
